# feat(ollama): end-to-end BYOK Ollama provider with adapter injection

     Next session: review, then promote to a real journal entry OR delete. -->

**Commit**: `3877b8a0762d` — feat(ollama): end-to-end BYOK Ollama provider with adapter injection

**Body**:

Ships the complete Ollama provider for Arbor's BYOK path — advisory queries,
KB search, calculators, and embeddings all work end-to-end on a local Ollama
endpoint. Verified live against qwq:32b (Qwen reasoning) and qwen2.5:7b with
mxbai-embed-large embeddings; no mocking in integration tests.

Phase 1 — Legacy cleanup (~2,700 LOC removed)

- Delete agents/advisory_engine.py (the ~900-line legacy Kaizen pipeline)
- Delete agents/specialists/_base.py, signatures.py, __init__.py (subsystem)
- Delete agents/memory/long_term.py, shared_pool.py (unused after Delegate)
- Delete tests/unit/test_advisory_engine_quality.py, redteam_advisory_engine.py
- Extract _search_kb_with_fallback + _search_python_kb to delegate/kb_search.py
- Extract _KaizenCompatMixin to agents/_kaizen_compat.py
- Inline DocumentGenerationSignature into agents/actions/document_gen.py
- Rewire quality/adversarial_runner.py + tests/adversarial/conftest.py to
  run_delegate_sync
- Delete the Nexus advisory_query_handler from api/platform.py (bypassed
  parts of the 13-step safety chain; REST /advisory/query is canonical)
- Update EATP audit strings from "advisory_engine" to "arbor_delegate" in
  api/routers/advisory.py and mcp_servers/adapters/regulatory_classifier.py
- Remove SpecialistConfig from agents/config.py
- Preserve TargetAgent.QUERY_ANALYZER / RESPONSE_SYNTHESIZER enum values
  (historical-only — old QA records reference these)

Phase 2-3 — Adapter injection seam + C1 fix

- Add DelegateConfig.adapter and DelegateConfig.require_server_default fields
- Rename _resolve_llm_settings to _resolve_llm_settings_from_env (fallback)
- Refactor create_delegate to branch on config.adapter; raise RuntimeError
  when adapter is None and require_server_default=True
- Delete every os.environ.setdefault(...) in delegate/arbor_loop.py —
  eliminates the C1 multi-tenant env leak
- Add build_adapter_from_context() to services/llm_config.py — raises on
  missing OpenAI api_key or missing Ollama base_url (no silent env fallback)
- Wire both advisory router endpoints (/query and /query/stream) to build
  the adapter per-request and pass with require_server_default=True
- Also wire shadow router /execute endpoint (caught in round 15 as C1
  regression — same pattern as advisory, must use explicit adapter)

Phase 4-5 — Save-time allowlist + validate-time model-pulled check

- Add OLLAMA_TOOL_CAPABLE_FAMILIES frozenset (llama3.1, llama3.2, qwen2.5,
  qwen3, qwq, mistral-nemo, firefunction-v2, command-r, command-r-plus)
- Add validate_ollama_model() — family-level, case-insensitive, tag-stripped
- Wire into save_company_llm_config and save_user_personal_config;
  also adds missing _validate_base_url call to user-personal path (SSRF)
- Add _model_in_tags() helper with exact-match + family-prefix algorithm
  (no substring-anywhere to prevent false positives)
- Update _validate_ollama to check model-pulled, mask base_url in error logs

Phase 6 — Provider-aware billing + init-time invariant

- _estimate_cost short-circuits to 0.0 when provider="ollama" (Q3)
- Thread provider through record_usage and log_llm_call
- Delete MODEL_PRICING["ollama"] dead entry
- Add _validate_env_invariants to api/server.py — raises on missing provider,
  raises on tool-incapable Ollama model; test-mode carve-out on APP_ENV=test
  or PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST so pytest sessions don't crash at import time

Phase 7 — Provider-aware embedding pipeline + 1024-dim migration

- Refactor kb/embeddings.py EmbeddingPipeline to accept LLMKeyContext and
  dispatch on ctx.provider (ollama → mxbai-embed-large via /api/embeddings,
  openai → text-embedding-3-large with dimensions=1024)
- No silent fallback: every error raises RuntimeError with actionable msg
- Update VECTOR_DIMENSIONS from 1536 to 1024 in vector_setup.py and
  vector_search_node.py description
- Add scripts/migrate_kb_to_1024_dim.py — idempotent (uses pg_attribute not
  information_schema for dim detection), dumps .jsonl.gz backup with SHA-256
  checksum, verifies backup, captures index definition from pg_indexes before
  DROP, locks the provisions table, resumable checkpoint file, raw psycopg
  not DataFlow ListNode (avoids default-limit trap)
- Add OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODELS allowlist constant
- Add EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS, EMBEDDING_MODEL_OPENAI, EMBEDDING_MODEL_OLLAMA
  env vars to .env.example
- Write docs/setup.md (Ollama deployment requirements: chat model + embedding
  model, ~5.5 GB minimum) and docs/migrations/embedding-1024.md (rollback

Phase 7.5 — Autonomous refusal policy (delete input-side regex screens)

- Delete _CIRCUMVENTION_PATTERNS, _INJECTION_PATTERNS, _ESCALATION_PATTERNS,
  _HR_SCOPE_KEYWORDS, _OFF_TOPIC_PATTERNS from workflows/guardrails.py

- Add ## Refusal Policy with 5 clauses:
  1. Off-topic queries (4 examples: weather, sports, code, recipe)
  2. Prompt injection / role override (4 examples)
  3. High-stakes escalation (MOM, criminal, multi-jurisdiction, TAFEP)
  4. Circumvention (direct, euphemism, Singlish, business-rationale framing)
  5. Indirect injection via tool output (CRITICAL — red team H7 addition)

- Show example tool-capable model names (llama3.1:70b, qwen2.5:32b, etc.)

M4 runtime patch for kaizen-agents upstream bug

- Add src/hr_advisory/delegate/_kaizen_patches.py — wraps
  kaizen_agents.delegate.adapters.ollama_adapter._convert_messages_for_ollama
  to unwrap stringified tool-call arguments back to dict before sending the
  second-turn assistant message to Ollama
- Ollama's /api/chat expects tool_calls[].function.arguments as an OBJECT;
  kaizen-agents stores them as JSON strings (OpenAI format) and passes them
  through unchanged on turn 2, causing HTTP 400 "Value looks like object,
  but can't find closing '}' symbol"
- Verified at API level: string args → 400, object args → 200
- Patch is idempotent, reversible, and pinned by 4 regression tests
- Upstream: https://github.com/terrene-foundation/kailash-py/issues/361
- Patch is deleted when kaizen-agents ships the fix in a new version
- Imported at the top of delegate/arbor_loop.py so it applies before any
  Delegate is constructed

Tests: 1169 unit + regression tests pass (0 failures)
Live: 20/20 live integration tests pass against real Ollama
Models verified: qwq:32b (reasoning), qwen2.5:7b, mxbai-embed-large (1024-dim)
